### C.

#### Kits

```{r}
genes<-read.csv("https://calvin-data304.netlify.app/data/twins-genetics-long.csv")
str(genes)
```

```{r}
vl_chart(height = 400, width = 600, title = "Genetic Share Across Twin Pairs by Kit") |>
  vl_mark_bar() |>
  vl_encode_x("pair:N", title = "Twin Pair ID") |>
  vl_encode_y("genetic.share:Q", title = "Genetic Share") |>
  vl_encode_color("kit:N", scale = list(scheme = "category10")) |>
  vl_facet_column("id:N", title = "ID Group") |>
  vl_add_data(genes)


```

```{r}
vl_chart(height = 500, width = 700, title = "Genetic Similarity Across DNA Test Kits") |>
  vl_mark_rect() |>  # Heatmap
  vl_encode_x("kit:N", title = "DNA Test Kit") |>
  vl_encode_y("pair:N", title = "Twin Pair") |>
  vl_encode_color("genetic.share:Q", scale = list(scheme = "viridis"), title = "Genetic Share") |>  # Proper scale definition
  vl_add_data(genes)


```
This heatmap shows how different DNA test kits report genetic share for each twin pair. The color intensity represents the reported genetic share, with darker color indicating lower similarity and lighter color indicating higher similarity. Further  more this graphic highlights the potential inconsistency of the DNA testing kits.
